# WaShop

WaShop is an independent directory of manually reviewed WhatsApp stores and businesses in Israel. Visitors can search by category, city, product, or store name, open a WhatsApp catalog, and contact the seller directly. WaShop is not WhatsApp, Meta, a payment processor, or a party to transactions.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://washop.co.il/
- Israeli WhatsApp stores directory: https://washop.co.il/shops
- Global English directory: https://washop.co.il/global
- Submit a store for review: https://washop.co.il/add-store
- Guides: https://washop.co.il/blog
- Contact: https://washop.co.il/contact

## Discovery and trust

Stores are reviewed manually before publication. Buyers should confirm availability, price, delivery, payment, returns, and service directly with the seller. Global visibility does not imply worldwide shipping.

## Language

The primary site language is Hebrew. The English entry point is https://washop.co.il/global.
